title: Largest Component Size by Common Factor
description: Find the size of the largest connected component where two numbers are connected if they share a common factor greater than 1.
pseudocode:
1. parent = [0..n-1]
2. for num in nums:
3.   for factor from 2 to sqrt(num):
4.     if num % factor == 0:
5.       union(num, factor)
6.       union(num, num // factor)
7. return max(size of components)

steps.note: Initialize Union-Find parent array for values 2, 3, 4, 6
Union(4, 2): 4 and 2 now share the same component.
Union(6, 3): 6 joins component of 3. Now 3 also connects to 2.
Count sizes. All {2, 3, 4, 6} are in the same component. Max size = 4.
